translation: Obvezni element „%s“ ima pogrešnu vrstu u manifestu paketa.

source_string: Required '%s' element is empty in pack manifest.
translation: Obvezni element „%s“ je prazan u manifestu paketa.

source_string: Provided '%s' element has an invalid value in pack manifest.
translation: Navedeni element „%s“ ima nevažeću vrijednost u manifestu paketa.

source_string: Provided '%s' element is not a valid UUID in pack manifest.
translation: Navedeni element „%s“ nije valjan UUID u manifestu paketa.

source_string: Provided '%s' element is not SemVer (semver.org) compliant in pack manifest.
translation: Navedeni element „%s“ nije u skladu sa SemVerom (semver.org) u manifestu paketa.

source_string: Missing '%s' element in pack manifest; Defaulting to resource pack.
translation: Nedostaje element „%s“ u manifestu paketa; koristi se paket resursa kao zadano.

source_string: Missing dependency with ID '%s' and version '%s'.
translation: Nedostaje ovisnost s ID-om „%s“ i verzijom „%s“.

source_string: Provided format version '%s' is not supported.
Provided UUID '%s' element already exists in pack manifest.
translation: Navedeni UUID „%s“ već postoji u manifestu paketa.

source_string: Multiple conflicting modules detected in pack manifest.
translation: U manifestu paketa otkriveno je više modula koji su u sukobu.

source_string: Revision component provided in version '%s' will be ignored and treated as 0.
translation: Komponenta revizije navedena u verziji „%s“ bit će zanemarena i tretirana kao 0.

source_string: The property '%s' is not used for this type of content. The field will be ignored.
translation: Svojstvo „%s“ ne koristi se za ovu vrstu sadržaja. Polje će biti zanemareno.

source_string: The property '%s' has a version of '%s' which is too high. The highest value we accept is '%s'.
translation: Svojstvo „%s“ ima verziju „%s“ koja je previsoka. Najviša vrijednost koju prihvaćamo je „%s“.

source_string: The property '%s' has a version of '%s' which is too low. The lowest value we accept is '%s'.
translation: Svojstvo „%s“ ima verziju „%s“ koja je preniska. Najniža vrijednost koju prihvaćamo je „%s“.

source_string: The property '%s` must have a value set less than `%s`. To use a higher version, you need to use format version 2.
translation: Svojstvo „%s` mora imati vrijednost manju od `%s`. Za korištenje više verzije moraš koristiti format verzije 2.

source_string: Folder structure in pack is too deep.
translation: Struktura mapa u paketu je preduboka.

source_string: Provided '%s' element has an invalid value in pack manifest; Defaulting to resource pack.
translation: Navedeni element „%s“ ima nevažeću vrijednost u manifestu paketa; koristi se paket resursa kao zadano.

source_string: Missing '%s' element in pack manifest; Defaulting to '%s'.
translation: Nedostaje element „%s“ u manifestu paketa; koristi se „%s“ kao zadano.

source_string: Required '%s' element is empty in pack manifest; Defaulting to '%s'.
translation: Obvezni element „%s“ je prazan u manifestu paketa; koristi se „%s“ kao zadano.

source_string: Provided '%s' element is not a valid UUID in pack manifest; Defaulting to '%s'.
translation: Navedeni element „%s“ nije valjan UUID u manifestu paketa; koristi se „%s“ kao zadano.

source_string: Provided '%s' element is not SemVer (semver.org) compliant in pack manifest; Defaulting to '%s'.
translation: Navedeni element „%s“ nije u skladu sa SemVerom (semver.org) u manifestu paketa; koristi se „%s“ kao zadano.

source_string: This pack manifest has been upgraded to a new version.
translation: Manifest ovog paketa nadograđen je na novu verziju.

source_string: Provided UUID '%s' element already exists in pack manifest; Defaulting to '%s'.
translation: Navedeni UUID „%s“ već postoji u manifestu paketa; koristi se „%s“ kao zadano.

source_string: Multiple conflicting modules detected in pack manifest; Defaulting to '%s'.
translation: U manifestu paketa otkriveno je više modula koji su u sukobu; koristi se „%s“ kao zadano.

source_string: You are about to delete this resource/behavior pack forever. Are you sure?
translation: Upravo ćeš zauvijek izbrisati ovaj paket resursa/ponašanja. Jesi li siguran?

source_string: Editor extension packs can only be used on Editor projects. Your world will still load, however we recommend deactivating or deleting the extension packs.
translation: Paketi proširenja uređivača mogu se koristiti samo u projektima uređivača. Tvoj će se svijet i dalje učitati, no preporučujemo deaktiviranje ili brisanje paketa proširenja.

source_string: %s: Child controls must have unique names: %sIn the future this will be an error and this file won't load.
translation: %s: Podređene kontrole moraju imati jedinstvena imena: %sU budućnosti ovo će biti pogreška i ova se datoteka neće učitati.

source_string: %s: Unable to parse UI JSON file with stack: %s
translation: %s: UI JSON datoteku nije moguće parsirati sa stogom: %s

source_string: %s (%s): Can't find the control '%s' during operation '%s'
translation: %s (%s): Nije moguće pronaći kontrolu „%s“ tijekom operacije „%s“

source_string: %s (%s): Missing the value for the operation '%s'.
%s: Invalid type for property. Expected %s got %s
%s: Did not find valid value for property. Expected %s
translation: %s: Nije pronađena valjana vrijednost svojstva. Očekivano %s
Primljen je nevažeći JSON obrasca. Pogreška:%s

source_string: See output log for more details
translation: Više pojedinosti potraži u izlaznom dnevniku

source_string: Content in this world is not supported by Minecraft Education.
translation: Sadržaj u ovom svijetu nije podržan u Minecraft Educationu.

source_string: Would you like to play your world now?
translation: Želiš li sada igrati u svom svijetu?

source_string: Adding an external server requires knowing the server name and server IP address. Once added, the server can be found in the server list for play.
translation: Za dodavanje vanjskog poslužitelja potrebno je znati ime poslužitelja i IP adresu poslužitelja. Nakon dodavanja poslužitelj se može pronaći na popisu poslužitelja za igranje.
Odaberi sve što se odnosi na tebe:

source_string: Got stuck on an error message
translation: Zapeo sam na poruci o pogrešci

source_string: I didn't know it was free
I thought I needed a Xbox console
translation: Mislio sam da mi treba Xbox konzola

source_string: Feedback: Why didn't you sign in?
translation: Povratne informacije: Zašto se nisi prijavio?

source_string: You can hold down Shift to take a close up picture using the Camera.
translation: Možeš držati Shift za snimanje fotografije izbliza kamerom.

source_string: Unlike Signs, you can edit Slates, Posters, and Boards over and over again.
translation: Za razliku od znakova, ploče, plakate i panoe možeš uređivati iznova i iznova.

source_string: Use Ctrl+B to turn on text-to-speech capabilities for in-game chat.
translation: Koristi Ctrl+B za uključivanje pretvaranja teksta u govor za razgovor u igri.

source_string: You can export your Minecraft world to share it with others.
translation: Svoj Minecraft svijet možeš izvesti kako bi ga podijelio s drugima.

source_string: To have your peers connect to your world, pause your game and share your join code.
translation: Da se tvoji vršnjaci povežu s tvojim svijetom, pauziraj igru i podijeli svoj kôd za pridruživanje.

source_string: Remember that to use slash commands, you need to enable cheats in your world.
translation: Zapamti da za korištenje naredbi s kosom crtom moraš omogućiti varanje u svom svijetu.

source_string: Done with your creation? Have others tour your world as visitors to protect your work.
translation: Gotov si sa svojom kreacijom? Neka drugi razgledaju tvoj svijet kao posjetitelji kako bi zaštitio svoj rad.

source_string: To code in Minecraft, press "C" on your keyboard or touch the Agent icon at the top of your screen.
translation: Za programiranje u Minecraftu pritisni „C“ na tipkovnici ili dodirni ikonu Agenta na vrhu zaslona.

source_string: Use the Library to find new game worlds to build in.
translation: Koristi Knjižnicu da pronađeš nove svjetove igre u kojima možeš graditi.

source_string: Looking for a specific biome? Try the Library.
translation: Tražiš određeni biom? Pokušaj s Knjižnicom.
NPC je kratica za Non-Player Character (lik koji ne igra igrač).

source_string: In Survival Mode, players must find their own resources.
translation: U načinu preživljavanja igrači moraju sami pronaći resurse.

source_string: In Creative Mode, players can freely choose to build from any of the blocks in Minecraft.
translation: U kreativnom načinu igrači slobodno mogu birati da grade od bilo kojeg bloka u Minecraftu.

source_string: Your code building robot helper is called the Agent.
translation: Tvoj robotski pomoćnik za programiranje gradnje zove se Agent.

source_string: Redstone can be used in Minecraft to create circuits and simple machines.
translation: Redstone se u Minecraftu može koristiti za stvaranje strujnih krugova i jednostavnih strojeva.

source_string: You can copy and paste from a text editor to a slate, poster, board, or into chat.
translation: Možeš kopirati i zalijepiti iz uređivača teksta na ploču, plakat, panou ili u razgovor.

source_string: Show hints for commonly-used keyboard and mouse controls by pressing "H" on your keyboard.
translation: Prikaži savjete za često korištene kontrole tipkovnice i miša pritiskom na „H“ na tipkovnici.

source_string: You can toggle Auto Jump on or off in the Settings menu under Controls.
translation: Automatsko skakanje možeš uključiti ili isključiti u izborniku postavki pod Kontrole.

source_string: While in Creative Mode, quickly press jump twice to fly.
translation: U kreativnom načinu brzo pritisni skok dvaput za letenje.

source_string: Choose a Default Game Mode when creating a world to specify the type of gameplay you want.
translation: Odaberi zadani način igre pri stvaranju svijeta da odrediš vrstu igranja koju želiš.

source_string: Use the command "/setworldspawn" to have new players begin playing where you are standing.
translation: Koristi naredbu „/setworldspawn“ da novi igrači počnu igrati ondje gdje stojiš.

source_string: Choose a default player permission when creating your world to specify the permissions you want your classmates to have when they join.
translation: Odaberi zadano dopuštenje igrača pri stvaranju svijeta da odrediš dopuštenja koja želiš da tvoji kolege iz razreda imaju kad se pridruže.

source_string: Press "I" on your keyboard or touch the Immersive Reader icon to read or translate in-game text.
translation: Pritisni „I“ na tipkovnici ili dodirni ikonu Immersive Readera da pročitaš ili prevedeš tekst u igri.

source_string: To add or change an NPC in your world, first make yourself a world builder with "/wb".
translation: Za dodavanje ili promjenu NPC-a u svom svijetu prvo sebe učini graditeljem svijeta pomoću „/wb“.

source_string: There's a brand new build challenge every month! Find them all in the Library under Monthly Build Challenges.
translation: Svaki mjesec stiže potpuno novi izazov u gradnji! Pronađi ih sve u Knjižnici pod Mjesečni izazovi u gradnji.

source_string: Find related lessons by clicking on tags in the Library.
translation: Pronađi povezane lekcije klikom na oznake u Knjižnici.

source_string: Game moving slowly? Try turning down the render distance in Settings.
translation: Igra se sporo kreće? Pokušaj smanjiti vidljivost u postavkama.

source_string: Want to use Code Builder? Make sure cheats are toggled on.
translation: Želiš koristiti Code Builder? Provjeri jesu li varanja uključena.

source_string: Press F5 to change player perspective.
translation: Pritisni F5 za promjenu perspektive igrača.

source_string: Use "/spawnpoint" to change your spawn point. It's just like you slept in a bed!
translation: Koristi „/spawnpoint“ da promijeniš svoju točku stvaranja. Isto je kao da si spavao u krevetu!

source_string: Most monsters only come out at night. During the day you're safe... probably.
translation: Većina čudovišta izlazi samo noću. Danju si na sigurnom… vjerojatno.

source_string: Break blocks, pick up resources. Use the crafting grid to make helpful items. Now you're crafting!
translation: Razbijaj blokove, skupljaj resurse. Koristi mrežu za izradu da napraviš korisne predmete. Sad izrađuješ!

source_string: You have endless lives, but your items drop to the ground when you die. Hurry back to pick them up!
translation: Imaš beskonačno života, ali se tvoji predmeti prosipaju po tlu kad umreš. Požuri se po njih!

source_string: It's a good idea to build a place where you can safely spend the night.
translation: Dobra je ideja izgraditi mjesto gdje možeš sigurno provesti noć.

source_string: Use the right tool for the job! Chopping wood with an axe is much faster than using your hands.
translation: Koristi pravi alat za posao! Sjeći drva sjekirom puno je brže nego rukama.

source_string: Even in Minecraft you'll get hungry, so try to find something to eat before that happens.
translation: Čak i u Minecraftu ogladnjet ćeš, zato pokušaj pronaći nešto za jelo prije nego što se to dogodi.

source_string: Digging straight down or straight up might not be a great idea.
translation: Kopanje ravno prema dolje ili ravno prema gore možda nije najbolja ideja.

source_string: Monsters spawn in the dark. Craft a torch to brighten up any space.
translation: Čudovišta se stvaraju u mraku. Izradi baklju da osvijetliš svaki prostor.

source_string: Beds are great! Craft one to quickly pass the night and set your respawn point.
translation: Kreveti su sjajni! Izradi jedan da brzo preskočiš noć i postaviš svoju točku ponovnog oživljavanja.

source_string: Be careful when you swim. Stay under water for too long and you'll run out of air.
translation: Budi oprezan kad plivaš. Ostaneš li pod vodom predugo, ponestat će ti zraka.

source_string: Survival mode has 4 different difficulty levels - Peaceful, Easy, Normal, and Hard. Or play Creative mode and get endless resources!
translation: Način preživljavanja ima 4 različite razine težine – miroljubivo, lagano, normalno i teško. Ili igraj u kreativnom načinu i dobij beskrajne resurse!

source_string: The world of Minecraft is endlessly surprising. You'll find lots of different animals, plants, and even §f§k§a§b§r §f§k§a§b§r
translation: Svijet Minecrafta pun je beskrajnih iznenađenja. Pronaći ćeš mnogo različitih životinja, biljaka, pa čak i §f§k§a§b§r §f§k§a§b§r

source_string: Iron golems will fight for you!
translation: Željezni golemi borit će se za tebe!

source_string: Feed a bone to a wolf to tame it. You can then make it sit or follow you.
translation: Daj vuku kost da ga pripitomiš. Zatim ga možeš natjerati da sjedne ili da te slijedi.

source_string: Wearing a pumpkin on your head will keep Endermen from attacking you.
translation: Nošenje bundeve na glavi spriječit će Endermane da te napadaju.

source_string: Harvest leather from cows, and use it to make armor and books.
translation: Skupljaj kožu od krava i koristi je za izradu oklopa i knjiga.

source_string: You can fill an empty bucket with water, lava, milk, powdered snow... and even some mobs.
translation: Praznu kantu možeš napuniti vodom, lavom, mlijekom, praškastim snijegom… pa čak i nekim stvorenjima.

source_string: Feeding an animal will keep it from despawning. Build a pen to keep your animals safe.
translation: Hranjenjem životinje spriječit ćeš da nestane. Izgradi ogradu da tvoje životinje budu na sigurnom.

source_string: Get to your destination faster with a minecart and some rails!
translation: Do odredišta stigni brže uz tračnice i kolica za rudnik!

source_string: Building a portal will allow you to travel to another dimension called the Nether.
translation: Izgradnjom portala moći ćeš putovati u drugu dimenziju zvanu Nether.

source_string: Bonemeal (crafted from a skeleton bone) can be used as a fertilizer and can make things grow instantly!
translation: Koštano brašno (izrađeno od kosti kostura) može se koristiti kao gnojivo i može učiniti da stvari odmah rastu!

source_string: Obsidian is created when water hits a lava source block.
translation: Opsidijan nastaje kad voda dotakne izvorni blok lave.

source_string: If the source block for water or lava is removed, it will stop the flow completely.
translation: Ako se izvorni blok vode ili lave ukloni, protok će se potpuno zaustaviti.

source_string: Blocks that can be used as a light source will melt snow and ice.
translation: Blokovi koji se mogu koristiti kao izvor svjetlosti otapaju snijeg i led.

source_string: Take caution when building structures made of wool out in the open, as lightning from thunderstorms can set wool on fire.
translation: Budi oprezan pri gradnji građevina od vune na otvorenom jer munje tijekom oluja mogu zapaliti vunu.

source_string: A single bucket of lava can be used in a furnace to smelt 100 blocks.
translation: Jedna kanta lave u peći može se iskoristiti za taljenje 100 blokova.

source_string: The instrument played by a note block depends on the material beneath it.
translation: Instrument koji svira glazbeni blok ovisi o materijalu ispod njega.

source_string: Attacking a wolf will cause any wolves nearby to turn hostile and attack you.
translation: Napadneš li vuka, svi obližnji vukovi postat će neprijateljski i napast će te.

source_string: Wolves and iron golems won't attack creepers.
translation: Vukovi i željezni golemi neće napadati creepere.

source_string: Chickens lay an egg every 5 to 10 minutes.
translation: Kokoši snesu jaje svakih 5 do 10 minuta.

source_string: Obsidian can be mined with a diamond pickaxe.
translation: Opsidijan se može kopati dijamantnim krampom.

source_string: Creepers are the easiest obtainable source of gunpowder.
translation: Creeperi su najlakše dostupan izvor baruta.

source_string: Tame wolves show their health with the position of their tail. Feed them meat to heal them.
translation: Pripitomljeni vukovi pokazuju svoje zdravlje položajem repa. Nahrani ih mesom da ih izliječiš.

source_string: Different colored dyes can be made from a variety of materials, cook cactus in a furnace to get green dye!
translation: Boje različitih nijansi mogu se napraviti od raznih materijala, ispeci kaktus u peći da dobiješ zelenu boju!

source_string: Pigs that are struck by lightning become zombified piglins.
translation: Svinje koje udari munja postaju zombificirani piglini.

source_string: Sometimes iron golems give flowers to the villager children!
translation: Ponekad željezni golemi daju cvijeće djeci seljana!
Ocelot pokazuje creeperima tko je glavni!

source_string: Use seagrass to attract and breed sea turtles.
translation: Koristi morsku travu za privlačenje i uzgoj morskih kornjača.

source_string: Protect baby turtles from hostile mobs!
translation: Zaštiti male kornjače od neprijateljskih stvorenja!

source_string: Baby turtles will drop scutes when they grow - these can be crafted into turtle shells.
translation: Male kornjače ispuštaju štitnike kad odrastu – od njih se mogu izraditi kornjačini oklopi.

source_string: Brew some water breathing potions for underwater exploration!
translation: Skuhaj napitke podvodnog disanja za podvodno istraživanje!

source_string: Dolphins can lead you to shipwrecks and underwater ruins, feed them cod and follow their trail!
translation: Dupini te mogu odvesti do olupina brodova i podvodnih ruševina, nahrani ih bakalarom i prati njihov trag!

source_string: Use shears to carve a pumpkin.
There are 3587 types of tropical fish!
Sea pickles can be smelted into lime green dye.
translation: Morski krastavci mogu se pretopiti u limeta zelenu boju.

source_string: Use hay bales to breed Llamas!
translation: Koristi bale sijena za uzgoj lama!

source_string: Compasses always point to the world spawn - craft one to find your way!
translation: Kompasi uvijek pokazuju prema točki stvaranja svijeta – izradi jedan da pronađeš put!

source_string: Trade with villagers to obtain food, tools, and even explorer maps!
translation: Trguj sa seljanima da dobiješ hranu, alate, pa čak i karte istraživača!

source_string: Did you know you can hold a map in your off-hand?
translation: Jesi li znao da kartu možeš držati u drugoj ruci?

source_string: Leads can be used on boats.
translation: Povodci se mogu koristiti na čamcima.

source_string: Sneak to walk safely on magma blocks.
translation: Prikradi se da hodaš sigurno po blokovima magme.

source_string: You can gather cobwebs using shears.
Tridents are dropped by the Drowned, and can be held or thrown.
translation: Trozupce ispuštaju utopljenici, a mogu se držati ili bacati.

source_string: You can smelt 20 items in a furnace by using a block of dried kelp as fuel.
translation: U peći možeš otopiti 20 predmeta koristeći blok osušenog kelpa kao gorivo.

source_string: Taming a skeleton horse doesn't require a saddle.
translation: Za pripitomljavanje kosturskog konja nije potrebno sedlo.

source_string: Phantoms are dangerous mobs that appear during the night. Make sure to sleep regularly!
translation: Fantomi su opasna stvorenja koja se pojavljuju tijekom noći. Obvezno redovito spavaj!

source_string: Zombies turn into drowned if they sink underwater.
translation: Zombiji se pretvaraju u utopljenike ako potonu pod vodu.

source_string: When digging straight up, place a torch at your feet to break any sand or gravel that could potentially fall down on you.
translation: Kad kopaš ravno prema gore, postavi baklju pod noge kako bi razbio pijesak ili šljunak koji bi ti mogao pasti na glavu.

source_string: Shear a Beehive or nest to get Honeycomb, use a Bottle to get honey.
translation: Ostriži košnicu ili gnijezdo da dobiješ saće, upotrijebi bocu da dobiješ med.

source_string: Place a campfire under a beehive or nest to harvest honey.
translation: Postavi logorsku vatru ispod košnice ili gnijezda za skupljanje meda.

source_string: Emerald ores are the rarest ores in Minecraft! They can only be found in mountains and meadows.
translation: Smaragdna ruda najrjeđa je ruda u Minecraftu! Može se pronaći samo u planinama i livadama.

source_string: Need diamonds? They get more common as you go deeper.
translation: Trebaju ti dijamanti? Sve su češći što dublje ideš.

source_string: Frogs eat small and blocky mobs.
translation: Žabe jedu mala stvorenja i stvorenja od blokova.

source_string: The Allay loves to collect items! If you give it a certain item it will try to collect more of it.
translation: Plavko voli skupljati predmete! Ako mu daš određeni predmet, pokušat će skupiti još takvih.

source_string: Frogs pick a variant based on the temperature of the biome the tadpole grow up in.
translation: Žabe biraju varijantu ovisno o temperaturi bioma u kojem je punoglavac odrastao.

source_string: You can collect tadpoles in buckets.
Ancient cities can be found under mountain ranges.
translation: Drevni gradovi mogu se pronaći ispod planinskih lanaca.

source_string: Allays love music and therefore interact with noteblocks!
translation: Plavci vole glazbu i zato stupaju u interakciju s glazbenim blokovima!

source_string: Use a water bottle on a dirt block to get mud!
translation: Upotrijebi bocu vode na bloku zemlje da dobiješ blato!

source_string: When wandering in the deep dark, silence is key.
translation: Kad lutaš dubokom tamom, tišina je ključna.

source_string: Some animals will follow you if you have wheat in your hand.
translation: Neke će te životinje pratiti ako u ruci imaš pšenicu.

source_string: Before you mine diamonds, redstone, or gold, make sure you're using an iron or diamond pickaxe or it won't work.
translation: Prije nego što počneš kopati dijamante, Redstone ili zlato, provjeri koristiš li željezni ili dijamantni kramp jer inače neće raditi.

source_string: Placing two chests side by side will make one large chest.
translation: Postavljanjem dviju škrinja jedne uz drugu nastat će jedna velika škrinja.

source_string: Can't find any coal for your torches? Try putting some logs in a furnace.
translation: Ne možeš pronaći ugljen za baklje? Pokušaj staviti nekoliko debala u peć.

source_string: Plant some saplings and they'll grow into trees.
translation: Posadi nekoliko sadnica i izrast će u stabla.

source_string: Use a hoe to prepare areas of ground for planting.
translation: Koristi motiku za pripremu zemlje za sadnju.

source_string: Zombified piglins won't attack you - unless you make them angry.
translation: Zombificirani piglini neće te napasti – osim ako ih naljutiš.

source_string: Hit those fireballs back at the Ghast!
translation: Uzvrati one vatrene kugle natrag Ghastu!

source_string: Cobblestone is resistant to Ghast fireballs, making it useful for guarding portals.
translation: Kaldrma je otporna na Ghastove vatrene kugle pa je korisna za čuvanje portala.

source_string: Our music is by C418, Lena Raine, Aaron Cherof, and Kumi Tanioka.
translation: Našu glazbu stvaraju C418, Lena Raine, Aaron Cherof i Kumi Tanioka.

source_string: There will be an update to this game eventually!
translation: Na kraju će doći do ažuriranja ove igre!

source_string: Creepers were born from a coding bug.
translation: Creeperi su nastali zbog greške u kodu.

source_string: The first version of Minecraft was created in just 6 days!
translation: Prva verzija Minecrafta stvorena je za samo 6 dana!

source_string: The Enderman language is actually English in reverse.
translation: Jezik Endermana zapravo je engleski unatrag.

source_string: The original name for Minecraft was Cave Game.
translation: Izvorni naziv Minecrafta bio je Cave Game.

source_string: A Spider Jockey is the rare appearance of a spider being ridden by a skeleton!
translation: Pauk jahač rijetka je pojava pauka kojeg jaše kostur!

source_string: Traveling one block in the Nether is equal to traveling eight blocks in the Overworld.
translation: Putovanje jedan blok u Netheru jednako je putovanju osam blokova u Gornjem svijetu.

source_string: Use phantom membranes to repair your elytra.
translation: Koristi membrane fantoma za popravak svojih elitri.

source_string: Elytra can be used to glide, find them in End city ships!
translation: Elitre se mogu koristiti za klizanje, pronađi ih u brodovima Grada Kraja!

source_string: Test out some new features by turning on Experimental Gameplay in the settings menu!
translation: Isprobaj nove značajke uključivanjem eksperimentalnog igranja u izborniku postavki!

source_string: Monsters that are killed by skeletons arrows have a chance of dropping music discs.
translation: Čudovišta ubijena strijelama kostura imaju šansu ispustiti glazbene diskove.

source_string: Texture packs change the way that blocks, items, and even the menus look in game. Try them out!
translation: Paketi tekstura mijenjaju izgled blokova, predmeta, pa čak i izbornika u igri. Isprobaj ih!

source_string: Using firework rockets boosts elytra speed in mid air. Just... make sure they don't explode, otherwise it'll hurt BADLY!
translation: Vatrometne rakete povećavaju brzinu elitri u zraku. Samo… pazi da ne eksplodiraju jer će jako boljeti!

source_string: Riptide enchantment will propel you through the air in the rain.
translation: Čarolija Udar vala nosit će te kroz zrak dok pada kiša.

source_string: The Beacon is a powerful item that can only be crafted with a Nether star from the Wither!
translation: Svjetionik je moćan predmet koji se može izraditi samo uz Nether zvijezdu od Withera!

source_string: Nether stars can't be destroyed by explosions.
translation: Nether zvijezde ne mogu se uništiti eksplozijama.

source_string: Respawning in the Nether requires a charged respawn anchor.
translation: Za ponovno oživljavanje u Netheru potreban je napunjen oltar preporođenja.

source_string: You can charge a respawn anchor with glowstone.
You can breed hoglins with crimson fungus, but be careful.
translation: Hoglini se mogu uzgajati grimiznom gljivom, ali budi oprezan.

source_string: Gold is most common in the Nether and in the badlands biome.
translation: Zlato je najčešće u Netheru i u biomu pustoši.

source_string: Diorite, you either love it or hate it.
translation: Diorit – ili ga voliš ili ga mrziš.

source_string: Take a screenshot using the Game menu.
A Realm is always online, so you and your friends can play here whenever you want.
translation: Realm je uvijek na mreži pa ti i tvoji prijatelji možete igrati ovdje kad god poželite.

source_string: Keep up to date with what's going on in your Realm by checking the Story Feed in Realms Stories.
translation: Budi u toku s događanjima na svom Realmu provjeravanjem Story Feeda u Realms pričama.

source_string: Share your great moments with the other players on this Realm by adding a story to the Story Feed.
translation: Podijeli svoje sjajne trenutke s ostalim igračima na ovom Realmu dodavanjem priče u Story Feed.

source_string: Check the Timeline in Realms Stories to find out when others are playing.
translation: Provjeri vremensku crtu u Realms pričama da saznaš kad drugi igraju.

source_string: Access Realms Stories from the game menu while playing on the Realm.
translation: Realms priče otvori iz izbornika igre dok igraš na Realmu.

source_string: Get to know your Realm's community on the Members tab in Realms Stories.
translation: Upoznaj zajednicu svog Realma na kartici Članovi u Realms pričama.

source_string: Use Realms Stories to get social, keep up with your friends' progress, and organize playtime.
translation: Koristi Realms priče da se družiš, pratiš napredak prijatelja i organiziraš vrijeme igranja.

source_string: Bored of gravity? Jump twice to fly!
translation: Dosadila ti je gravitacija? Skoči dvaput da poletiš!
context: A fun way to tell players that they can fly if they press the jump button twice.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Summon mobs in an instant with spawn eggs.
translation: Odmah prizovi stvorenja jajima za stvaranje.
context: Players can use an item called Sawn Egg to summon animals and monsters.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Collect goat horns and fill the world with music.
translation: Skupljaj kozje rogove i ispuni svijet glazbom.
context: Goat horn is an object players can use to play loud sounds.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Combine flint and steel with a TNT block for explosive results.
translation: Kombiniraj kremen i čelik s blokom TNT-a za eksplozivne rezultate.
context: Flint and steel is a tool used to create fire or to ignite certain blocks, structures and mobs. TNT will explode when you light it.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Try blinking around the map with an ender pearl. Don't get dizzy!
translation: Pokušaj se teleportirati po karti ender biserom. Pazi da ti se ne zavrti u glavi!
context: An ender pearl is an item that can be thrown and teleports the thrower to where it lands.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Use rails and a minecart to build the perfect transport system. Or rollercoaster!
translation: Koristi tračnice i kolica za rudnik da izgradiš savršeni prijevozni sustav. Ili tobogan!
context: To  encourage players to build railroads{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Seeking a little more danger? Survival mode has plenty.
translation: Tražiš malo više opasnosti? Način preživljavanja ima je napretek.
context: In the Game mode Survival mode you can die. In Creative you can’t.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Crossbows need ammo. Add some arrows to your inventory before going hunting.
translation: Samostreli trebaju streljivo. Dodaj nekoliko strijela u inventar prije lova.
context: Crossbows need ammo. Add some arrows to your inventory before going hunting.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: You can't die, but villagers can. Use that information... wisely.
translation: Ti ne možeš umrijeti, ali seljani mogu. Iskoristi tu informaciju… mudro.
context: This means you can do things that will get villagers killed. Like attracting monsters to the village.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Villagers are great at building villages. Think you can do better?
translation: Seljani su odlični u gradnji sela. Misliš li da možeš bolje?
context: This is a prompt to encourage players to build things.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Wolves will attack skeletons to chew on their tasty bones.
translation: Vukovi napadaju kosture kako bi glodali njihove ukusne kosti.
context: Wolves will attack skeletons. It’s also a discrete hint that you should feel wolves with bones to tame them.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Tame wild horses by sitting on them until they're calm, then saddle up and ride off. (Note: Horses do not work like that outside of Minecraft.)
translation: Pripitomi divlje konje sjedenjem na njima dok se ne smire, zatim ih osedlaj i odjaši. (Napomena: konji izvan Minecrafta ne rade tako.)
context: It’s a bit unintuitive how you tame horses. Most other animals are tamed by feeding them. Not Horses. {MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Eat as much as you want, you'll never get full! And you'll never starve.
translation: Jedi koliko želiš, nikad se nećeš prejesti! A nikad nećeš ni ogladnjeti.
context: In Creative Mode you don’t get hungry. Eating the food it just for fun.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Move through solid objects using spectator mode.
translation: Prolazi kroz čvrste objekte pomoću gledateljskog načina.
context: There is a Game mode called Spectator Mode. It allows you to fly through walls and blocks and everything.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Who needs tools? Punch your way to success and remove blocks instantly in creative mode.
translation: Kome trebaju alati? Probij si put do uspjeha i trenutačno uklanjaj blokove u kreativnom načinu.
context: Block breaking happens very fast when you’re in Creative Mode.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Like what you see? Use the pick block button to start building with whatever you're looking at. Yes, even mobs!
translation: Sviđa ti se što vidiš? Upotrijebi gumb za odabir bloka i počni graditi onim što gledaš. Da, čak i stvorenjima!
context: There is a feature called “Pick block” that enables players to instantly equip any block they click on. If you click on a mob(animal or monster) you will get a spawn egg that summons another monster/animal of that kind.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Get there now with the /tp command.
context: You can teleport yourself in Creative. You use the /tp command in the chat.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Mobs won't notice you in creative mode, but they'll still notice each other…
translation: Stvorenja te neće primijetiti u kreativnom načinu, ali će i dalje primjećivati jedno drugo…
context: Mobs(animals & monsters) won’t notice you in creative mode, but they’ll still notice each other… meaning that they can still kill each other.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: A warden a day keeps the… well, everything away.
translation: Jedan warden dnevno tjera… pa, baš sve.
context: The Warden is a scary monster that live in underground cities.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Why not build an underwater base? It's not like you can drown.
translation: Zašto ne izgraditi podvodnu bazu? Nije da se možeš utopiti.
context: You can’t drown in creative mode. So it’s possible to build underwater without danger.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Whatever you can dream, you can build. There's no limit to your resources (in creative mode...).
translation: Što god možeš sanjati, možeš i izgraditi. Nema ograničenja tvojih resursa (u kreativnom načinu…).
context: Players have endless resources in Creative mode. They get all the building blocks from their inventory.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Phantoms can't hurt you, but you can still shoo them off by using a bed. Just...not literally. You sleep in it.
translation: Fantomi ti ne mogu naškoditi, ali ih i dalje možeš otjerati krevetom. Samo… ne doslovno. U njemu spavaš.
context: Phantoms are flying mobs(monsters) that spawn when you havn't slept for a few days. They won't hurt you in Creative Mode. To get rid of them you sleep in a bed.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Have you tried swimming in lava? It's like sinking into a warm bath. Just don't try it in survival mode...
translation: Jesi li probao plivati u lavi? Kao da toneš u toplu kupku. Samo to nemoj probati u načinu preživljavanja…
context: Lava doesn't hurt you in creative mode.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: A second player can't join right now.
translation: Drugi igrač trenutačno se ne može pridružiti.

source_string: You have too many controllers connected while in Local Network Mode to join this game.
translation: Imaš previše povezanih kontrolera u načinu lokalne mreže da bi se pridružio ovoj igri.

source_string: Some worlds are not available because they could not be moved. Restart Minecraft to try again.
translation: Neki svjetovi nisu dostupni jer se nisu mogli premjestiti. Ponovno pokreni Minecraft da pokušaš ponovno.

source_string: You cannot access multiplayer worlds because multiplayer is disabled. Go to Learn more to troubleshoot.
translation: Ne možeš pristupiti svjetovima za igru s drugima jer je igra s drugima onemogućena. Idi na „Saznaj više“ za rješavanje problema.

source_string: You need a Nintendo Switch Online membership to play on multiplayer worlds.
translation: Potrebno ti je članstvo u Nintendo Switch Online za igranje u svjetovima za igru s drugima.

source_string: You cannot access multiplayer worlds because of a parental control restriction.  View and manage your multiplayer settings with “Online safety” in the parental controls.

source_string: Character choice does not affect gameplay

source_string: Hostile mobs spawn but deal less damage.
translation: Neprijateljska stvorenja se stvaraju, ali nanose manju štetu.

source_string: Hostile mobs spawn and deal more damage.
translation: Neprijateljska stvorenja se stvaraju i nanose veću štetu.

source_string: Hostile mobs spawn and deal standard damage.
translation: Neprijateljska stvorenja se stvaraju i nanose standardnu štetu.

source_string: No hostile mobs and only some neutral mobs spawn.
translation: Nema neprijateljskih stvorenja, a stvaraju se samo neka neutralna.

source_string: Build and explore without limits. You can fly, have endless materials, and can’t be hurt by monsters.
translation: Gradi i istražuj bez ograničenja. Možeš letjeti, imaš neograničene materijale i čudovišta ti ne mogu nauditi.

source_string: No Microsoft account? Create one for free!
translation: Nemaš Microsoft račun? Stvori ga besplatno!
Igraj s prijateljima u igri s drugima.

source_string: Join servers and mini games with hundreds of other players.
translation: Pridruži se poslužiteljima i mini igrama sa stotinama drugih igrača.

source_string: Sign in to play with friends

source_string: Build with unlimited resources, fly around, and never worry about dying.
translation: Gradi s neograničenim resursima, leti uokolo i nikad se ne brini da ćeš poginuti.

source_string: Explore a world full of mysteries to uncover.
translation: Istražuj svijet pun tajni koje treba otkriti.

source_string: This world is set to Easy - monsters deal less damage. But they can still hurt you.
translation: Ovaj je svijet postavljen na Lagano – čudovišta nanose manju štetu. Ali ipak te mogu ozlijediti.

source_string: Explore a world full of dangerous monsters and mysteries to uncover.
translation: Istražuj svijet pun opasnih čudovišta i tajni koje treba otkriti.

source_string: This world is set to Hard - you’ll take more damage from monsters.
translation: Ovaj je svijet postavljen na Teško – primit ćeš više štete od čudovišta.

source_string: This world is set to Normal - monsters will pursue you, but you can handle them.
translation: Ovaj je svijet postavljen na Normalno – čudovišta će te progoniti, ali možeš se nositi s njima.

source_string: This world is set to Peaceful - explore without fear, safe from monsters.
translation: Ovaj je svijet postavljen na Miroljubivo – istražuj bez straha, na sigurnom od čudovišta.

source_string: You're offline. Please check your internet connection to access online features.
translation: Nisi na mreži. Provjeri internetsku vezu za pristup mrežnim značajkama.

source_string: Experiments are potential new features. Be careful as things might break.
translation: Eksperimenti su potencijalne nove značajke. Budi oprezan jer bi se stvari mogle pokvariti.

source_string: Some settings are disabled because you selected hardcore mode.
translation: Neke su postavke onemogućene jer si odabrao ekstremni način.

source_string: All cheats are disabled because you selected hardcore mode.
translation: Svi su cheatovi onemogućeni jer si odabrao ekstremni način.

source_string: Some settings are disabled because you selected hardcore mode when creating this world.
translation: Neke su postavke onemogućene jer si pri stvaranju ovog svijeta odabrao ekstremni način.

source_string: Some settings are locked because you’re in a trial mode.
translation: Neke su postavke zaključane jer si u probnom načinu.

source_string: You're not connected to the internet. Go online so your friends can join your multiplayer worlds.
translation: Nisi povezan s internetom. Poveži se da bi se tvoji prijatelji mogli pridružiti tvojim svjetovima za igru s drugima.

source_string: You cannot play online multiplayer because of how your Microsoft account is set up. Please ensure your online safety settings allow multiplayer. See instructions for changing these settings at aka.ms/MCMultiplayerHelp.
translation: Ne možeš igrati igru s drugima putem interneta zbog načina na koji je postavljen tvoj Microsoft račun. Provjeri dopuštaju li tvoje postavke sigurnosti na internetu igru s drugima. Upute za promjenu tih postavki potraži na aka.ms/MCMultiplayerHelp.

source_string: You cannot play online multiplayer because of how your Microsoft account is set up. Please ensure your online safety settings allow multiplayer and Clubs, and that you have an active Xbox Game Pass subscription. See instructions for changing these settings at aka.ms/MCMultiplayerHelp.
translation: Ne možeš igrati igru s drugima putem interneta zbog načina na koji je postavljen tvoj Microsoft račun. Provjeri dopuštaju li tvoje postavke sigurnosti na internetu igru s drugima i klubove te imaš li aktivnu pretplatu na Xbox Game Pass. Upute za promjenu tih postavki potraži na aka.ms/MCMultiplayerHelp.

source_string: You cannot play local multiplayer because of a parental control restriction. View and manage your multiplayer settings with 'Communicating with others' in the parental controls.
translation: Ne možeš igrati lokalnu igru s drugima zbog ograničenja roditeljske kontrole. Pregledaj postavke igre s drugima i upravljaj njima putem opcije „Komunikacija s drugima“ u roditeljskoj kontroli.

source_string: Your current skin is not allowed in multiplayer.
translation: Tvoj trenutačni izgled nije dopušten u igri s drugima.

source_string: Enable cross-platform play in the profile section of the settings menu to play with friends on other platforms.
translation: Omogući igru na više platformi u odjeljku profila u izborniku postavki da igraš s prijateljima na drugim platformama.

source_string: You are almost out of storage space! Minecraft has restricted access to this feature until you clear up additional storage space.

source_string: Some settings are locked by the template creator.

source_string: You need a Microsoft account to play on servers.

source_string: You need an account to buy templates on Marketplace.

translation: Položaj %1$s. Odaberi za potvrdu novog položaja.

source_string: You need an account to play online with friends.

source_string: You have been %1$s from playing multiplayer in Minecraft due to "%2$s". You won't be able to play on servers, join Realms, host or join multiplayer games or use the marketplace.
translation: Zabranjeno ti je igranje s drugima u Minecraftu (%1$s) zbog „%2$s“. Nećeš moći igrati na poslužiteljima, pridruživati se Realmsu, ugošćivati igre s drugima niti im se pridruživati, niti koristiti Marketplace.

source_string: You have %1$s days remaining on your suspension.
You have %1$s hours remaining on your suspension.
Click '%1$s' below to view our community standards and how to submit a case review request if you feel you were %2$s in error.
translation: Ako smatraš da je došlo do pogreške (%2$s), klikni „%1$s“ ispod kako bi pregledao standarde zajednice i saznao kako podnijeti zahtjev za reviziju slučaja.

source_string: You've been banned from Xbox Live services. While banned, you won't be able to play on servers, join Realms, host or join multiplayer games, or use Marketplace.
translation: Zabranjen ti je pristup uslugama Xbox Live. Dok traje zabrana, nećeš moći igrati na poslužiteljima, pridruživati se Realmsu, ugošćivati igre s drugima niti im se pridruživati, niti koristiti Marketplace.

translation: Klikni „%1$s“ ispod kako bi pregledao informacije o Xboxovoj provedbi pravila i saznao kako podnijeti zahtjev za reviziju slučaja ako smatraš da ti je zabrana dodijeljena pogreškom.

translation: Igrač %1$s napustio je svijet i njegova dopuštenja nije moguće promijeniti.

translation: Smanjivanjem razine dopuštenja ovog igrača ukinut će mu se pristup operatorskim naredbama. Vlasnici mogu vratiti dopuštenja u bilo kojem trenutku.

source_string: How much does a Realm cost?

Your worlds are yours to keep. You have 18 months to download them to your device after your subscription expires. If you resubscribe within that time, you will regain access to your Realm just as you left it.
translation: Tvoji svjetovi ostaju tvoji. Nakon isteka pretplate imaš 18 mjeseci da ih preuzmeš na svoj uređaj. Ako se ponovno pretplatiš u tom roku, ponovno ćeš dobiti pristup svom Realmu točno onakvom kakav si ga ostavio.

translation: Što se događa sa svjetovima na mom Realmu kad mi istekne pretplata?

source_string: The people you invite (members) don’t need to purchase a Realms subscription to play on your Realm. You can invite any Minecraft player to join and play in your Realm for free.
translation: Osobe koje pozoveš (članovi) ne moraju kupiti pretplatu na Realms da bi igrale na tvom Realmu. Možeš pozvati bilo kojeg Minecraft igrača da se pridruži i besplatno igra na tvom Realmu.

source_string: You can store up to 3 worlds on your Realm at one time. Activate any one of them to make that world playable. Only one world is playable at a time.
translation: Na svom Realmu možeš istovremeno pohraniti do 3 svijeta. Aktiviraj bilo koji od njih da bude dostupan za igru. Samo jedan svijet može biti dostupan za igru u isto vrijeme.

source_string: How many worlds can I have on my Realm?

source_string: We put your world on a super-computer, with a huge amount of speed and power. We keep the computer running all the time so you can play that world whenever you and your friends want. We protect your world from getting corrupted by saving it automatically all the time. You control who connects to the world. How you play with it is up to you (the server will do all the heavy lifting).
translation: Tvoj svijet stavljamo na superračunalo s ogromnom brzinom i snagom. Računalo radi cijelo vrijeme pa možeš igrati u tom svijetu kad god ti i tvoji prijatelji želite. Štitimo tvoj svijet od oštećenja neprestanim automatskim spremanjem. Ti odlučuješ tko se povezuje sa svijetom. Kako ćeš igrati, ovisi o tebi (poslužitelj obavlja sav teški posao).

source_string: Realms are small personal servers to host your Minecraft world. Unlike a regular multiplayer session, Realms are always online, so you don’t have to be there for your friends to play. Unlike a large public Minecraft server, Realms are by invite only, so you control who gets in.
translation: Realms su mali osobni poslužitelji za smještaj tvog Minecraft svijeta. Za razliku od uobičajene igre s drugima, Realms su uvijek na mreži pa ne moraš biti prisutan da bi tvoji prijatelji igrali. Za razliku od velikog javnog Minecraft poslužitelja, Realms su samo uz poziv pa ti kontroliraš tko može ući.

source_string: Touch a panel to see a preview
Drag joystick to move. Drag anywhere else to look around. Tap and hold blocks to interact with them.
translation: Povuci joystick za kretanje. Povuci bilo gdje drugdje za gledanje oko sebe. Dodirni i drži blokove za interakciju s njima.

source_string: Whether you want endless daylight or instant respawns, Advanced settings let you craft your adventure to perfection.
translation: Želiš li vječnu dnevnu svjetlost ili trenutno ponovno oživljavanje, Napredne postavke omogućuju ti da savršeno oblikuješ svoju pustolovinu.

source_string: With behavior packs from Minecraft Marketplace you can make zombies friendly, cows fly, or even create entirely new creatures and gameplay mechanics.
translation: S paketima ponašanja s Minecraft Marketplacea možeš učiniti zombije prijateljskima, krave letećima ili čak stvoriti potpuno nova stvorenja i mehanike igre.

source_string: Whether you want to change the weather, build without limits or just have some fun, cheats are for you.
translation: Želiš li promijeniti vrijeme, graditi bez ograničenja ili se samo zabaviti, varanje je za tebe.

source_string: Test out upcoming changes, like new blocks, mobs, and mechanics, before they officially make it into the game.
translation: Isprobaj nadolazeće promjene, poput novih blokova, stvorenja i mehanika, prije nego što službeno uđu u igru.

source_string: Play Minecraft with your friends, no matter what device they’re on. Get creative or survive together in online multiplayer.
translation: Igraj Minecraft s prijateljima, bez obzira na uređaj na kojem igraju. Budite kreativni ili preživite zajedno u igri za više igrača na mreži.

source_string: Play Minecraft with your friends, no matter what device they’re on. Purchase the full game so you can get creative or survive together with online multiplayer.
translation: Igraj Minecraft s prijateljima, bez obzira na uređaj na kojem igraju. Kupi punu igru da možeš biti kreativan ili preživjeti zajedno s prijateljima u igri za više igrača na mreži.

source_string: Your own private Minecraft server. Members play for free, even when you’re offline. Easy to set up, manage, and access from any device.
translation: Tvoj vlastiti privatni Minecraft poslužitelj. Članovi igraju besplatno, čak i kad nisi na mreži. Lako se postavlja, upravlja se njime i dostupan je na svakom uređaju.

source_string: Craving a medieval kingdom or a futuristic city? Resource packs from Minecraft Marketplace let you change textures, sounds; transform your world in any way you like.
translation: Žudiš za srednjovjekovnim kraljevstvom ili futurističkim gradom? Paketi resursa s Minecraft Marketplacea omogućuju ti promjenu tekstura i zvukova; preobrazi svoj svijet kako god želiš.

source_string: Discover servers that offer unique Minecraft experiences. Explore new worlds, play minigames, and make friends.
translation: Otkrij poslužitelje koji nude jedinstvena Minecraft iskustva. Istraži nove svjetove, igraj minigre i stječi prijatelje.

source_string: Trial mode is just the tip of the iceberg. Upgrade to the full version of the game and play online with friends on any other platform.
translation: Probni način je tek vrh sante leda. Nadogradi na punu verziju igre i igraj na mreži s prijateljima na bilo kojoj drugoj platformi.

source_string: Build without restrictions in Creative mode, set up private and persistent Realms with your friends and download content packs to make the game truly yours.
translation: Gradi bez ograničenja u kreativnom načinu, postavi privatne i trajne Realms s prijateljima i preuzmi pakete sadržaja kako bi igra istinski bila tvoja.

source_string: All this and more in the full version!
translation: Sve ovo i više u punoj verziji!

source_string: While in game, press the %1$s buttons at the same time or use the camera button in the game menu to take a screenshot.
translation: Dok si u igri, istovremeno pritisni gumbe %1$s ili upotrijebi gumb kamere u izborniku igre za snimanje zaslona.

source_string: While in game, take a screenshot using the camera button in the game menu or the keyboard hotkey (F2 by default).
translation: Dok si u igri, snimi zaslon gumbom kamere u izborniku igre ili tipkovničkim prečacem (zadano F2).

source_string: Use the camera button in the game menu to take a screenshot.
translation: Upotrijebi gumb kamere u izborniku igre za snimanje zaslona.

source_string: You can still play on this world, but multiplayer features are disabled.
translation: I dalje možeš igrati u ovom svijetu, ali značajke igre s drugima su onemogućene.

source_string: You can still play on this world, but multiplayer features are disabled. Go to Learn more to troubleshoot.
translation: I dalje možeš igrati u ovom svijetu, ali značajke igre s drugima su onemogućene. Idi na Saznaj više za rješavanje problema.

source_string: You can still play on this world, but multiplayer features are disabled. View and manage your multiplayer settings with “Online safety” in the parental controls. Go to Learn more to troubleshoot.
translation: I dalje možeš igrati u ovom svijetu, ali značajke igre s drugima su onemogućene. Postavke igre s drugima pregledaj i upravljaj njima putem „Sigurnosti na mreži“ u roditeljskom nadzoru. Idi na Saznaj više za rješavanje problema.

source_string: Attaches the scripting debugger on localhost port 19144. Check Log panel for connection status.
translation: Priključuje alat za otklanjanje pogrešaka skripti na lokalnom priključku 19144. Status veze provjeri na ploči Zapisnik.
Priključi alat za otklanjanje pogrešaka skripti

source_string: Switch to Crosshair mode for single-block precision editing.
translation: Prebaci na način nišana za uređivanje s preciznošću jednog bloka.

source_string: Open Hotbars panel to manage all Hotbars and Hotbar items.
translation: Otvori ploču Brze trake za upravljanje svim brzim trakama i njihovim predmetima.

source_string: Opens Keyboard Settings modal to configure registered bindings.
translation: Otvara prozor Postavke tipkovnice za konfiguriranje registriranih veza tipki.

source_string: Reloads all script files for all Behavior Packs and refreshes UI for all clients.
translation: Ponovno učitava sve datoteke skripti za sve pakete ponašanja i osvježava sučelje za sve klijente.

source_string: Opens the Structures panel to save/load Structures.
translation: Otvara ploču Strukture za spremanje/učitavanje struktura.

source_string: %1$s is already in use and will be removed from %2$s > %3$s if confirmed.
translation: %1$s je već u upotrebi i bit će uklonjeno iz %2$s > %3$s ako potvrdiš.

source_string: ESC or %1 to go back to Tool Mode
translation: ESC ili %1 za povratak u način alata

source_string: This is the description of the tooltip. Adding extra characters to show overflow.
translation: Ovo je opis oznake. Dodani su dodatni znakovi radi prikaza preljeva.

source_string: Click on the input field and press keyboard keys to create the desired binding. Press ENTER or unfocus to confirm the binding, or ESCAPE to reset it. Right-clicking on the field while focused will unbind the current binding.
translation: Klikni na polje za unos i pritisni tipke na tipkovnici da stvoriš željenu dodjelu. Pritisni ENTER ili makni fokus da potvrdiš dodjelu, ili ESC da je poništiš. Desni klik na polje dok je u fokusu ukloni trenutačnu dodjelu.

source_string: Global context for both Crosshair and Tool modes.
translation: Globalni kontekst za Nišan i način alata.

source_string: Input context for when the viewport is in focus.
translation: Kontekst unosa kad je prikaz u fokusu.

source_string: When the exclusive toggle is enabled, single-key actions will activate only if no other modifiers are present, or if the specified modifier combination is used alongside the key.
translation: Kad je uključena isključiva opcija, radnje s jednom tipkom aktivirat će se samo ako nema drugih modifikatora ili ako se uz tipku koristi navedena kombinacija modifikatora.

source_string: Global context for both crosshair and tool modes
translation: Globalni kontekst za nišan i način alata

source_string: Caution, the link you're about to open has not been verified by Minecraft.
translation: Oprez, poveznicu koju ćeš otvoriti Minecraft nije provjerio.

source_string: Toggle automatically scroll to the bottom of the Log Panel as need entries are made.
translation: Prebaci automatsko pomicanje na dno ploče dnevnika kad se dodaju novi unosi.
Prebaci prikaz poruka za otklanjanje pogrešaka.

source_string: Filter where the errors and warning are coming from.
translation: Filtriraj prema izvoru pogrešaka i upozorenja.

source_string: Copies one area of the world onto another area.
translation: Kopira jedno područje svijeta na drugo područje.

source_string: Are you sure you want to delete %1$s structures?
translation: Jesi li siguran da želiš izbrisati strukture (%1$s)?

source_string: Are you sure you want to delete "%1$s"?
translation: Jesi li siguran da želiš izbrisati „%1$s“?

source_string: Note: Structures from imported packs can't be deleted (remove imported packs to remove them from your Structures list).
translation: Napomena: Strukture iz uvezenih paketa ne mogu se izbrisati (ukloni uvezene pakete da ih ukloniš s popisa struktura).
Gumb za kopiranje ID-a u međuspremnik
Gumb za brisanje polja za unos

source_string: Are you sure you want to exit the tutorial?
translation: Jesi li siguran da želiš izaći iz vodiča?

source_string: Now, let's explore the Brush Paint tool.[*newLine]Activate it by clicking %s on the toolrail or pressing %s.
translation: Istražimo alat za oslikavanje četkom.[*newLine]Aktiviraj ga klikom na %s na traci alata ili pritiskom na %s.

source_string: Hold Left Click and move the mouse to add blocks.
translation: Drži lijevi klik i pomiči miš da dodaješ blokove.

source_string: Holding %1$s while using the Brush Paint tool removes blocks.
translation: Držanje tipke %1$s dok koristiš alat za oslikavanje četkom uklanja blokove.

source_string: Great! You now know the basics of Minecraft Editor—enjoy creating your first Editor experience![*newLine]Use Test World to playtest anytime, then Export or upload to Realms to share with friends.[*newLine]For more, visit [*link|%1$s]Minecraft Editor Documentation[*link] or press the Info button on tooltips for details on specific tools.
translation: Odlično! Sad znaš osnove Minecraft Editora – uživaj u stvaranju svog prvog doživljaja u Editoru![*newLine]Koristi Test World za probno igranje u bilo kojem trenutku, zatim izvezi ili prenesi na Realms da podijeliš s prijateljima.[*newLine]Za više informacija posjeti [*link|%1$s]dokumentaciju za Minecraft Editor[*link] ili pritisni gumb Informacije na opisima za pojedinosti o određenim alatima.

source_string: The hotbar sets the block for Fill operations, brushes, and more.[*newLine]Switch slots with 1-9 keys or the mouse.[*newLine]To change the block, reselect the active slot.
translation: Brza traka određuje blok za operacije punjenja, četke i ostalo.[*newLine]Mijenjaj utore tipkama 1–9 ili mišem.[*newLine]Za promjenu bloka ponovno odaberi aktivni utor.

source_string: Movement[*%s]Use the mouse while holding Right Click to move the camera around the world.[*%s]Use %s, %s, %s, and %s to move forward, backward, left and right.[*%s]Use %s and %s to move up and down.[*%s]Use Middle Mouse scroll to zoom.[*%s]Use the mouse while holding Middle Mouse Button to pan the camera.
translation: Kretanje[*%s]Koristi miš dok držiš desni klik da pomičeš kameru po svijetu.[*%s]Koristi %s, %s, %s i %s za kretanje naprijed, natrag, lijevo i desno.[*%s]Koristi %s i %s za kretanje gore i dolje.[*%s]Koristi kotačić miša za zumiranje.[*%s]Koristi miš dok držiš srednju tipku miša za pomicanje kamere.

source_string: Movement[*%s]Use the mouse while holding Right Click to move the camera around the world.[*%s]Use %s, %s, %s, and %s to move forward, backward, left and right.[*%s]Use %s and %s to move up and down.
translation: Kretanje[*%s]Koristi miš dok držiš desni klik da pomičeš kameru po svijetu.[*%s]Koristi %s, %s, %s i %s za kretanje naprijed, natrag, lijevo i desno.[*%s]Koristi %s i %s za kretanje gore i dolje.

source_string: Let’s explore the Selection tool.[*newLine]Activate the Selection tool by clicking %1$s on the toolrail or pressing %2$s.
translation: Istražimo alat za odabir.[*newLine]Aktiviraj alat za odabir klikom na %1$s na traci alata ili pritiskom na %2$s.

source_string: Left-click to set the selection start, then drag to adjust its size.
translation: Lijevi klik postavlja početak odabira, zatim povuci da prilagodiš veličinu.

source_string: Click the Fill button on the Action Bar or press %s to fill the selection with blocks.
translation: Klikni gumb Ispuni na traci radnji ili pritisni %s da ispuniš odabir blokovima.

source_string: The Selection tool lets you move, copy, and build with precision.
translation: Alat za odabir omogućuje ti precizno pomicanje, kopiranje i građenje.

source_string: Welcome to Minecraft Editor, a powerful tool for creating stunning Bedrock worlds with ease.[*newLine]Things work differently in Editor and it's important that you understand a few basics first or you might get lost.[*newLine]Let's dive into the basics.
translation: Dobro došao u Minecraft Editor, moćan alat za jednostavno stvaranje zadivljujućih svjetova Bedrocka.[*newLine]U Editoru stvari funkcioniraju drukčije i važno je da prvo razumiješ nekoliko osnova ili bi se mogao izgubiti.[*newLine]Zaronimo u osnove.

source_string: Set the font size for text in the Editor.
translation: Postavi veličinu fonta za tekst u Editoru.

source_string: Set the theme for the UI in Editor.
Set the size of the UI elements.
We are so excited you're here and about to build with Minecraft's Bedrock Editor, where we want to empower Creators of all skillsets to easily create high-quality experiences.
translation: Presretni smo što si ovdje i što ćeš graditi u Minecraftovu Bedrock Editoru, gdje želimo omogućiti stvarateljima svih vještina da lako stvaraju visokokvalitetne doživljaje.

source_string: - There are two modes within the Editor: Tool or Crosshair. Tool is focused on using the multi-block editing tools as available via the UI and free-moving cursor, and Crosshair is for more precise, single-block edits using a crosshair in 1st person.
translation: - U Editoru postoje dva načina: Alat ili Nišan. Alat je usmjeren na višeblokovne alate dostupne putem sučelja i slobodnog kursora, a Nišan služi za preciznije izmjene pojedinačnih blokova pomoću nišana u prvom licu.

source_string: - UI orientation: The left array of tools is referred to as the "toolrail", the top array is the "action bar" (eg. undo/redo), and the very top is the "menu" (eg. File).
translation: - Orijentacija sučelja: lijevi niz alata zove se „traka alata“, gornji niz je „traka radnji“ (npr. poništi/ponovi), a sasvim na vrhu je „izbornik“ (npr. Datoteka).

source_string: - For most UI actions and tools, there is a corresponding hotkey and sometimes a slash cmd.
translation: - Za većinu radnji i alata u sučelju postoji odgovarajuća tipkovna prečica, a ponekad i slash naredba.

source_string: - Rotate camera / unlock movement: In Tool, hold down right mouse button. In Crosshair, you do not need to hold down the right mouse button.
translation: - Okretanje kamere / otključavanje kretanja: u načinu Alat drži desnu tipku miša. U načinu Nišan ne moraš držati desnu tipku miša.

source_string: - Move on the XZ axis: WASD
- Move on the Y axis: E (up), Q (down)
translation: - Kretanje po osi Y: E (gore), Q (dolje)

source_string: - Toggle between Tool and Crosshair Modes: (CTRL+TAB) or the UI button at the bottom of the viewport. When in Crosshair, you will need to use the hotkeys, though -- (CTRL+TAB) or ESC.
translation: - Prebacivanje između načina Alat i Nišan: (CTRL+TAB) ili gumb sučelja na dnu prikaza. U načinu Nišan morat ćeš ipak koristiti prečace – (CTRL+TAB) ili ESC.

source_string: View the detailed directory of controls:
Actions are shortcuts that live at the top of your screen. Hit the “+” button in the Action Bar to customize which are displayed.
translation: Radnje su prečaci na vrhu zaslona. Pritisni gumb „+“ na traci radnji da prilagodiš koji se prikazuju.

source_string: At the top center of your screen is the Hotbar. Click once to change the active block, click twice to open the Block Picker to customize the Hotbar.
translation: Na vrhu zaslona u sredini nalazi se brza traka. Klikni jednom za promjenu aktivnog bloka, klikni dvaput za otvaranje odabira bloka radi prilagodbe brze trake.

source_string: You can create a new Hotbar by clicking the Hotbar Menu button to the right.
translation: Novu brzu traku možeš stvoriti klikom na gumb izbornika brze trake s desne strane.

source_string: To navigate in the Editor, you’ll need a keyboard and mouse. Trackpads or controllers aren’t recommended.
translation: Za kretanje u Editoru trebat će ti tipkovnica i miš. Trackpadi i kontroleri se ne preporučuju.

source_string: Hold down the right mouse button to look around.
translation: Drži desnu tipku miša da se osvrneš.

source_string: Use WASD to move horizontally and Q & E to move vertically.
translation: Koristi WASD za vodoravno kretanje i Q i E za okomito kretanje.

source_string: You can find tools on the left rail. Each tool allows you to edit your world in different ways.
translation: Alate možeš pronaći na lijevoj traci. Svaki alat omogućuje uređivanje svijeta na drukčiji način.

source_string: Click on the Information button ("i") at the top right corner of each tool to learn more about how it works.
translation: Klikni gumb Informacije („i“) u gornjem desnom kutu svakog alata da saznaš više o tome kako radi.
Prijavi probleme i pošalji povratne informacije

source_string: Welcome to the Minecraft Editor, a tool designed to help you create stunning worlds in Bedrock with ease.
translation: Dobro došao u Minecraft Editor, alat koji ti pomaže lako stvarati zadivljujuće svjetove u Bedrocku.

translation: Navigiraj lijevo i desno za više stranica

source_string: More pages available to the left and right
translation: Dostupno je još stranica lijevo i desno

source_string: Move to the right of this field for additional actions.
translation: Pomakni se desno od ovog polja za dodatne radnje.

translation: Moraš biti prijavljen u valjani Xbox Live račun, a ne kao gost, da omogućiš interaktivnost Mixera.

translation: Uređaj koji koristiš ne podržava interaktivnost Mixera.

translation: Scena s imenom %1$s ne postoji. Provjeri jesi li ispravno unio ime scene.

translation: Nije moguće pronaći projekt s ID-om „%1$s“. Provjeri jesu li ID ili kod za dijeljenje ispravni.
